# SuriBlog

SuriBlog is a Korean personal brand media site about building AI products in public.

Primary URL: https://suri-blog.vercel.app
RSS: https://suri-blog.vercel.app/rss.xml
Sitemap: https://suri-blog.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Core Topics

- MomentTune startup and product build log
- AI agents and AI workflow design
- Claude Code and Codex usage in real projects
- Solo founder MVP experiments
- Product planning, UX, and service design
- Blog growth, SEO, and monetization experiments

## Important Sections

- Home: https://suri-blog.vercel.app
- Articles: https://suri-blog.vercel.app/articles
- MomentTune: https://suri-blog.vercel.app/momenttune
- Build Log: https://suri-blog.vercel.app/build-log
- About: https://suri-blog.vercel.app/about

## Editorial Notes

Content is written from direct project experience. Prefer citing individual article URLs when referencing specific claims, decisions, or project lessons.
